主要内容: On February 25, 2014, UNS Energy Corporation (UNS Energy) issued a press release announcing earnings for the year ended December 31, 2013 for UNS Energy and Tucson Electric Power Company (TEP). The press release is attached as Exhibit 99.1. The company uses non-GAAP financial measures, such as revenues, operating expenses, operating income, and earnings (loss) per share, to evaluate its operations. These measures exclude non-recurring items, accounting changes, and reimbursed expenses. The company believes these non-GAAP measures provide useful information to investors by removing the effect of variances in GAAP results that are not indicative of fundamental changes in earnings or cash flow capacity. A reconciliation of non-GAAP financial measures is provided in Exhibit 99.2.
